summary: OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 Flash is documented on a model-specific OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint with dated price and privacy claims; unsupported controls and residency remain unknown.
Ollama-native discovery exposes model metadata and capabilities; OpenAI compatibility is partial and version/model specific, while native timing and keep-alive fields still require pinned fixtures.
llama.cpp server behavior is build/model sensitive across protocols, context, reasoning, structured output, monitoring, and network/offline controls.
Provider routing must separate protocol, deployment, privacy metadata, credentials, explicit egress consent, capability confidence, and named fallback policy.
Content-free lifecycle telemetry can cover assembly, provider, validation, commit/fallback, concurrency, cancellation, and retry using pseudonymous correlation and result enums.
Perceptual parity requires deterministic rejection gates followed by repeated blinded human scoring; automatic metrics remain diagnostic only.
Six dependency-ordered phases give contracts, core, providers, runtime adapters, evaluation, and release hardening independent acceptance gates.
Architecture questions are answered, but exact implementation mappings remain gated on version-pinned runtime, dialect, provider, build, and model fixtures with byte-identical original goldens.

text: Provider name or OpenAI compatibility as a privacy/capability class.
